reflect.off_course: Captain's log: what went off course today?
reflect.proud_of: Log one manoeuvre from today that you are proud of.
reflect.learned: Record one new data point you gathered today.
reflect.surprised: Anomaly report: what caught you off guard today?
reflect.hardest_moment: Log the roughest turbulence of the day and how you steered through it.
reflect.energy: Power check: what charged your reserves today, and what drained them?
reflect.would_redo: If you could replay today's flight path, what would you adjust?
reflect.avoided: What did you leave unlaunched today, and what held it on the pad?
reflect.turning_point: Mark the moment today when your heading changed. What shifted?
reflect.habit_win: Which mission objective did you complete today, and how did it feel?
reflect.time_well_spent: Which stretch of today's flight time was best spent?
reflect.stuck_on: Flag the fault that has stalled your progress. What is jamming the controls?
reflect.someone_helped: Crew report: who did you assist today, or who assisted you?
reflect.change_mind: Update your navigation charts: what have you changed your mind about?
reflect.old_self: Send a transmission back one year. What does your past self need to hear?
gratitude.small_win: Report one small victory from today's mission.
gratitude.person: Name the crew member you are glad to have aboard.
gratitude.comfort: Which small comfort made the cabin feel like home today?
gratitude.unexpected: Log a pleasant surprise from today's flight.
gratitude.body: Commend your life-support system: what did your body do well today?
gratitude.place: Mark a place on your star chart that made you feel good.
gratitude.skill: Which piece of training are you glad to carry aboard?
gratitude.taste: Rations report: what tasted good today?
gratitude.kindness: Log one act of kindness observed today.
gratitude.challenge: Which hard stretch of the route is teaching you the most?
gratitude.morning: Recall this morning's launch window. What was good about it?
gratitude.tech: Which instrument or tool performed well for you today?
gratitude.nature: Note one natural sight from today worthy of the observation deck.
gratitude.memory: A happy memory has surfaced from the archive. Log it.
gratitude.tomorrow: What are you looking forward to on tomorrow's flight plan?
goals.this_week: Define a successful week: what would make this mission phase a good one?
goals.one_thing: Identify the single objective that matters most next.
goals.first_step: Plot the first small manoeuvre towards a distant destination.
goals.obstacle: Chart an obstacle on your route, and the course around it.
goals.habit_next: Which new mission objective will you add to your flight plan?
goals.stop_doing: What drag on the ship are you ready to jettison?
goals.month_ahead: Where should your orbit be in thirty days?
goals.stretch: Which objective will extend your range a little further?
goals.who_help: Which crew member could support you with an objective?
goals.finish: Name one task you will bring in to land.
goals.learn: Which new skill will you load into the flight computer?
goals.rest_plan: Schedule your next rest period. How will you recharge?
goals.big_picture: Zoom out to the star map: where is today's effort steering you?
goals.tiny_win: Name a small objective you can secure on tomorrow's flight.
wellbeing.mood_word: Status check: one word for how you feel.
wellbeing.body_check: Run a systems scan. How does your body feel right now?
wellbeing.sleep: Rest-cycle report: how did you sleep, and what would help?
wellbeing.stress: What is weighing on the ship right now? Name it plainly.
wellbeing.recharge: What restores your reserves when they run low?
wellbeing.boundaries: Log a boundary you held today, or one you need to set.
wellbeing.breath: Hold position. Take one slow breath and report what you notice.
wellbeing.move: Log your movement for the day. How did you move?
wellbeing.screen_time: Screen exposure report: how did screens leave you feeling today?
wellbeing.connection: Log today's contact: who did you connect with?
wellbeing.fuel: Fuel report: how did you refuel yourself today?
wellbeing.worry_park: Which worry can you dock outside the hatch for tonight?
wellbeing.joy: Log a moment of joy from today's flight.
wellbeing.kind_self: Send yourself a kind transmission. What does it say?
wellbeing.pause: When did you go to standby today, and what did it give you?
